sub_site: hip joint: synovial fluid and articular cartilage (OA vs femoral neck fracture); acetabular fossa excluded (n=2 passed)

evidence.quote: Specimens including synovial fluid, articular cartilage, and acetabular fossa tissue were collected from patients with primary hip osteoarthritis
The V3–V4 hypervariable region of the 16S-rRNA gene was selected for amplification
as well as environmental contaminants, were removed before diversity and abundance analyses
Following removal of low-depth samples and contaminant taxa—including Chloroflexi , Planctomycetota , Cyanobacteria , Hydrogenophilus , and Massilia

notes: 120 samples from 40 patients; 59 yielded data (15 SF, 6 AF, 38 CA); 53 SF+CA analysed. No negative controls mentioned; basis for removing 'environmental contaminants' (Hydrogenophilus, Massilia, several phyla) not stated. Authors caution Pseudomonas/Staphylococcus are known sequencing contaminants and represent 'DNA signatures', not viable bacteria (kept unflagged). Cartilage counted as joint tissue. No supplements available.
